description: Two independent percussive impulse generators for pinging resonators, one on the top half of the panel and one on the bottom

params.text: Sets how fast the impulse dies away, 1 at the far left to 1000 at the far right; higher settings give a shorter, brighter click
Adds noise to the fold that shapes the impulse, from none at the far left to full at the far right
Sets how far each hit is allowed to differ from the last: at every trigger a fresh random amount between zero and this setting is added to the second fold's offset

inputs.text: Fires the impulse on that half. Any rise in voltage fires it, so this is not a threshold: a slow ramp retriggers it every sample it climbs

outputs.text: The impulse from that half, the difference of two folded copies of the decaying envelope

notes: Flick-EXT adds pitch and level control voltages for both halves, and goes immediately to the LEFT of this module, not the right
